differences.what: A module, exam_heent_ears, that the General note type includes: its section Ears shows only while HEENT (exam.systems is heent) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10, 11

differences.what: External ear, Ear canal and Tympanic membrane are each recorded for the right ear and the left (sides).
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 18; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the inventory asks the clinical team to confirm sides for the ears

differences.what: External ear is choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others.
Ear canal is choose-many. Clear is the normal option and clears the others.
Tympanic membrane is choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others. Unable to visualize is neither normal nor abnormal.

Hearing is choose-one: Grossly intact (the normal option) or Decreased. The sub-choice Right, Left, Bilateral is a field of its own, Hearing decreased on, choose-one from the shared list side, shown only while Hearing is Decreased.
The empty bullet is not typed.
